cells.comment: Home and move to absolute position

Send G-code to read device parameters
(output is returned as a list)
Change Z axis speed, move fast up, restore speed, move down slowly
cells.code:
print(stage.send_gcode('M203 Z50'))  # increase z speed to 50
stage.move_relative(0, 0, 40)        # go up fast
print(stage.send_gcode('M203 Z5'))   # restore z speed to 5
stage.move_relative(0, 0, -40)       # go down slowly
